instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: InnovateSoft is a growing B2B SaaS provider specializing in supply chain optimization software for mid-sized enterprises. We focus on predictive analytics and workflow automation within the logistics sector. While our core operations are stable, we face increasing regulatory scrutiny regarding data privacy and cross-border compliance.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have implemented several incremental updates to our existing platform focusing on user interface improvements and feature enhancements. Our previous major initiative involved pilot testing a new AI module for forecasting demand, which showed promise but lacked full enterprise rollout.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is to achieve sustainable revenue growth by penetrating adjacent market segments. We aim to establish InnovateSoft as a leader in integrated digital solutions across multiple industries.
answers.teamSize: The core team consists of 15 highly skilled engineers and product managers, showing strong technical capability but with limited cross-functional representation.

opportunities.title: Platform Modularization for Vertical Expansion
opportunities.rationale: To diversify revenue streams, we should modularize our core software into specialized sub-products targeting distinct vertical markets (e.g., healthcare logistics or financial compliance). This leverages existing code while creating new sales channels.

first_actions: Conduct market research on three high-potential adjacent industries.
Establish a dedicated 'Venture' product team with cross-functional leads.
Define the MVP scope for one new vertical module.
resources_needed: $25,000 for initial market research and prototyping tools
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% of new revenue from diversified modules within 18 months.
milestones: Q3: Finalize business case and product roadmap for vertical A.
Q4: Launch MVP of Vertical A module.
Year 2 End: Achieve $5M in diversified revenue.

opportunities.title: Acquire Niche Compliance Tech Startup
opportunities.rationale: To rapidly diversify our service portfolio and gain expertise in complex regulatory niches, acquiring a smaller, specialized compliance technology firm is a high-impact radical move. This bypasses years of internal development.

first_actions: Identify 5 target acquisition candidates with proprietary AI/compliance tools.
Develop preliminary valuation model and due diligence playbook.
resources_needed: $100,000 for legal counsel, due diligence, and initial acquisition capital reserves
Internal assignment of executive leadership time
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful integration and revenue contribution from acquired entity within 9 months.
milestones: Month 1-3: Complete target identification and initial outreach.
Month 4-6: Finalize deal terms and secure financing.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Customer Journey Personalization
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging our existing data infrastructure, we can implement an incremental AI layer to personalize customer onboarding and retention. This improves efficiency and increases customer lifetime value (CLV) without requiring a major system overhaul.

first_actions: Pilot a machine learning model for personalized product recommendations in the existing platform.
Develop internal training modules for sales and support teams.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase customer retention rate by 8% within one year.
milestones: Q1: Implement data pipeline enhancements and model training setup.
Q3: Full platform rollout of personalized recommendation engine.
Year End: Achieve target CLV increase.

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional steering committee dedicated to identifying three potential adjacent market sectors.
Initiate a detailed feasibility study and financial modeling for the 'Acquire Niche Compliance Tech Startup' opportunity.
Draft the modularization roadmap, including required skill gap analysis for internal teams.

key_weaknesses: Limited cross-functional representation in leadership teams
Reliance on a single core software product line (lack of revenue diversification)
High turnover risk among specialized engineering talent
Slow internal process for radical innovation vetting
